title: 子矩阵元素加一
summary: 初始 n×n 零矩阵，每个查询把闭区间矩形 [row1,col1] 到 [row2,col2] 全部加一，返回最终矩阵。
insight: 用二维差分对每个矩形只修改四个角，再计算二维前缀和恢复每个格子的累计增量。
pitfalls: 查询右下边界是包含的
差分数组开到 n+1 便于处理 row2+1、col2+1
恢复时要减去重复计算的左上前缀

solutions.title: 二维差分与前缀和
solutions.idea: 矩形更新常数时间、最终统一恢复。

code.java: class Solution { public int[][] rangeAddQueries(int n,int[][] queries){int[][] difference=new int[n+1][n+1];for(int[] query:queries){int r1=query[0],c1=query[1],r2=query[2],c2=query[3];difference[r1][c1]++;difference[r2+1][c1]--;difference[r1][c2+1]--;difference[r2+1][c2+1]++;}int[][] answer=new int[n][n];for(int row=0;row<n;row++)for(int col=0;col<n;col++)answer[row][col]=difference[row][col]+(row>0?answer[row-1][col]:0)+(col>0?answer[row][col-1]:0)-(row>0&&col>0?answer[row-1][col-1]:0);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun rangeAddQueries(n:Int,queries:Array<IntArray>):Array<IntArray>{val difference=Array(n+1){IntArray(n+1)};for(query in queries){val r1=query[0];val c1=query[1];val r2=query[2];val c2=query[3];difference[r1][c1]++;difference[r2+1][c1]--;difference[r1][c2+1]--;difference[r2+1][c2+1]++};val answer=Array(n){IntArray(n)};for(row in 0 until n)for(col in 0 until n)answer[row][col]=difference[row][col]+(if(row>0)answer[row-1][col]else 0)+(if(col>0)answer[row][col-1]else 0)-(if(row>0&&col>0)answer[row-1][col-1]else 0);return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<vector<int>> rangeAddQueries(int n,vector<vector<int>>& queries){vector<vector<int>> difference(n+1,vector<int>(n+1));for(auto& query:queries){int r1=query[0],c1=query[1],r2=query[2],c2=query[3];++difference[r1][c1];--difference[r2+1][c1];--difference[r1][c2+1];++difference[r2+1][c2+1];}vector<vector<int>> answer(n,vector<int>(n));for(int row=0;row<n;++row)for(int col=0;col<n;++col)answer[row][col]=difference[row][col]+(row?answer[row-1][col]:0)+(col?answer[row][col-1]:0)-(row&&col?answer[row-1][col-1]:0);return answer;} };
